int_name: N BROAD ST & W WINGOHOCKING ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane urban street with a marked continental crosswalk and signalized control. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and high-visibility markings are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and wide lanes suggest a higher-speed environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a physical refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: Wide, straight lanes can encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway extending into the background

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and provide physical protection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signals within a mixed-use urban environment. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the crossing distance is relatively wide without refuge islands or curb extensions, and sidewalks are partially obstructed by debris.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Trash bags and debris are piled on the sidewalk near the corner, narrowing the usable path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The lack of curb extensions or a median increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic while crossing the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and street furniture at the corner can partially block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show the remaining time to cross, improving pedestrian decision-making and safety.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, but the wide multi-lane roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians. The environment is dominated by commercial land use with multiple vehicle conflict points and lacks physical traffic calming measures like refuge islands or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, blue van parked near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt near the crosswalk could present a minor tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and basic traffic signals, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads. While sidewalks are present on both sides, a large tree on the corner may partially obstruct sightlines between motorists and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree on the corner obscures the view of pedestrians for approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible walk/don't walk signals for pedestrians at a signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear right-of-way information and improve safety.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Improve sightlines by trimming the tree canopy and ensuring no parking near the crosswalk.

interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and make pedestrians more visible to drivers.
